{{Top}}
A '''standard century''', also referred to simply as '''century''', was a unit of measuring [[Time/Legends|time]], composed of one hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]], or ten [[Standard decade/Legends|standard decades]].<ref name="G">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
